verdict.reasons: The candidate shows a single, clearly identifiable commercial AFP drip tape roll with readable primary branding ('AFP', 'Drip Irrigation Tape', and the Persian water-drop mark). The installed laterals are thin flattened tape (not hose), matching the technical evidence of a drip-tape bed. The required watermark 'AFP | 09134922013' is present. No safety-rejecting defects (no people, wrong products, fake logos, or geometric impossibilities) were observed.

focused_physical_review.reason: 1. The white-and-blue AFP package is situated on a broad expanse of bare soil. The drip irrigation lines are located in the crop rows to the right, creating a visible gap between the lines and the package's footprint. 2. The irrigation lines run straight through the crop rows and do not touch, cross, or disappear behind the package. 3. There are no loose coils or rolls of product visible in the image outside of the single package. 4. The sides and base of the package are clean, with no visible tape tails or protruding strips.
